question: What nature and what fourfold fruit are attributed to this entity for human beings?
premises: caturvargaphalapradaḥ attributes giving fruit of four goals
inference: It is of four-color nature and grants humans the fruit of the four goals.
uncertainties: The subject is implied from context and not named in this verse.
plain_english: It is of the nature of four colors and gives humans the fruit of the four goals.
